gaps.sentence: The meeting has been ___ forward to Monday.
gaps.explanation: 'bring forward' = move to an earlier time (opposite of put off).

gaps.sentence: She's very good ___ explaining difficult ideas.
I'll call you as soon ___ I land.
There was so ___ confusion that the event was abandoned.
___ further delay, the doors opened and we went in.
She denied ___ the last piece of cake.
She's been ___ from school three times this term.
gaps.explanation: 'be absent from school' — formal way to say not present.

gaps.sentence: Unless it ___ , the match will go ahead.
gaps.explanation: 'unless' = if…not; present simple after time/condition words.
